stories.title: Mumbai: Two golden jackals killed at same spot on Airoli-Mulund Link Road
stories.summary: A golden jackal was killed in a road accident on the Airoli-Mulund Link Road on Friday, November 27, raising fresh concerns over recurring wildlife deaths on the busy stretch. stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat

From Bhringraj and amla in Ayurveda to rosemary in contemporary hair care conversations, several plant-based ingredients are gaining attention. However, understanding what the evidence actually supports is important when choosing a hair care routine.

stories.title: Health Dept. prepared to handle KFD cases in Shivamogga, says Khader
stories.summary: T. Khader has said that his department is equipped to prevent the spread of Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD) in Shivamogga, and that a special ward with 10 beds has been set up in every taluk hospital in the district. stories.title: Men's Health Awareness Month 2026 highlights why men delay check-ups; a physician warns that ignoring health can have dire consequences
stories.summary: Men often postpone routine health check-ups, sometimes until symptoms become severe enough to disrupt their daily lives. This behaviour is influenced by several factors, including busy work schedules, family responsibilities, fear of medical diagnoses, lack of awareness, and the belief that feeling physically fit means being healthy.

stories.title: IPL 2027: Rohit Sharma back in the saddle for Mumbai Indians
stories.summary: Rohit Sharma, three years after being stripped of captaincy, has been reinstated as Mumbai Indians skipper for the Indian Premier League 2027, returning to the role in which he led the franchise to all five of its IPL titles. After trading Hardik Pandya, who led the side for three seasons, to Punjab Kings, Mumbai has turned to the man behind its most successful era.

stories.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India outclass Malaysia, set up final against China
stories.summary: Defending champions India produced a commanding display to defeat Malaysia 6–2 in the semi-final of the women's Asian Champions Trophy at the International Sports Complex in Bhopal on Friday, securing their place in the final for a sixth time. Tournament's top scorer Deepika Sehrawat scored twice, while Mumtaz Khan, Navneet Kaur, Sunelita Toppo and Ishika found the mark once each.

stories.title: Syed Modi badminton: Unnati to clash with Tanvi in semi-final
stories.summary: The absence of India’s biggest badminton names may have robbed the Syed Modi India International of some star appeal, but the tournament is turning out to be rewarding for the country’s second rung. Young Indian shuttlers are making their presence felt, with Unnati Hooda and Tanvi Sharma ensuring an all-Indian women’s singles semi-final on Friday.

stories.title: Rohit Sharma back as Mumbai Indians captain; five-time winner to lead MI in IPL 2027
stories.summary: Rohit Sharma will return as Mumbai Indians captain for the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season, the franchise announced on Friday. The announcement comes following Hardik Pandya's trade to Punjab Kings (PBKS) ahead of the IPL 2027 auction next month. Hardik had replaced Rohit as Mumbai Indians captain ahead of the 2024 season, following his return to the franchise from Gujarat Titans.

stories.summary: The saga of Aaron Rodgers' controversial departure from the Pittsburgh Steelers continued Friday, even as the team recorded a win in their first game since Rodgers left. Rodgers on Friday seemingly responded to Tom Brady , who accused the former Steelers quarterback of violating dressing-room sanctity by going public about his fallout with Steelers management.

stories.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Azharuddeen’s century powers Kerala into the Super League
stories.summary: Mohammed Azharuddeen’s signature rocking-the-bat celebration has become a defining moment in this season’s Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy T20 cricket tournament. The opening batter brought it out once again on Friday for his second T20 hundred (101, 57b, 8x4, 6x6) which dismantled Himachal Pradesh and helped Kerala register a 67-run win to qualify for the Super League.

stories.title: Syed Modi Int'l: Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand enter QF

stories.title: 'Siraj needs help': Ashwin urges India team to show compassion after repeated snubs
stories.summary: Ravichandran Ashwin has urged the Indian team management and players to show compassion towards Mohammed Siraj following the fast bowler's consecutive omissions from the playing XI in the two-Test series against New Zealand. stories.title: Lyon dropped! Cummins continues as captain as Aus announce squad for NZ series
